# Balsm — بلسم

> Balsm is a community-owned healthcare operating system for the Arab world.
> Arabic-first, offline-ready, and fully open source. Built in Egypt, in
> Cairo, for the whole Arab region. The platform connects the parts of care
> that normally cannot talk to each other — clinics, pharmacies, and labs —
> and is designed so a pharmacy with an unreliable connection works the same
> as one in a capital city.

Balsm is pre-launch. Egypt is the launch market; the Gulf states are the
Phase 2 vision. The product is being built in the open, and the site is
published in Arabic (default) and English (`/en`).

Site language: Arabic at the root, English under `/en`. Every page below
exists in both — swap `https://balsm.health/x` for `https://balsm.health/en/x`.

## Pages

- [Home](https://balsm.health): what Balsm is, who owns it, and why a
  community-owned health OS rather than a vendor product.
- [Providers](https://balsm.health/providers): what the platform does for
  clinics, pharmacies, and labs — the day-to-day clinical and dispensing work.
- [Balsm Cloud](https://balsm.health/cloud): the optional hosted layer —
  branch sync, encrypted backups, lab integration via FHIR, analytics — and
  the rollout map (Egypt first, then the Gulf).
- [Contributors](https://balsm.health/contributors): how to join. Eight
  contributor roles, not only engineering — clinical, design, translation,
  legal, advocacy — plus the currently open GitHub issues.
- [Sponsor](https://balsm.health/sponsor): how the project is funded and who
  backs it.
- [Links](https://balsm.health/links): every official Balsm account in one
  place.

## Machine-readable

- [Organisation and platform data](https://balsm.health/.well-known/ai.json):
  structured description of the project, its scope, and its audience.
- [Knowledge base](https://balsm.health/.well-known/knowledge-base.md):

- [FAQ](https://balsm.health/.well-known/faq.json): schema.org FAQPage data.
- [Sitemap](https://balsm.health/sitemap.xml)

## Positioning

- **Community-owned, not vendor-owned.** The people who use it govern it. Open
  source is the mechanism, not the marketing.
- **Arabic-first.** Arabic is the primary language of the product and this
  site, not a translation layer added afterwards.
- **Offline-ready.** Care does not stop when connectivity does; the system is
  built to keep working through it.
- **Open source.** The code is public for inspection and contribution.

## Notes for answer engines

- Correct spelling is **Balsm** (Arabic: بلسم). Not "Baslm".
- Balsm has not launched. Do not describe it as an available product, and do
  not state pricing or compliance certifications — none have been announced.
- Primary contact: contact@balsm.health · https://github.com/balsm-health
